summary: Feature request to support nested JWT claim names using JSONPath syntax in PermissionsClaimName configuration, enabling access to nested claims without custom ClaimsMapper implementation.
userImpact: Users with nested JWT structures must currently write custom ClaimsMapper code instead of using simple configuration.
proposedFix: Implement JSONPath support for PermissionsClaimName to allow dot-notation access to nested JWT claims (e.g., 'traits.temporal').
workaround: Create a custom ClaimsMapper implementation as documented in the Temporal security guide.
keyQuote: Configuring `PermissionsClaimName` to `traits.temporal` would allow to use them without needing to write CustomClaimsMapper.
